purpose: Walk-forward precision/recall test of technical ranking for future 2x and 3x price peaks; not a probability forecast.

dataset.note: Exploratory comparison across the same historical folds; any winner requires an untouched holdout before adoption.

label_definition.2x: At least one future daily close >= 2x the next-session open within the horizon.
label_definition.3x: At least one future daily close >= 3x the next-session open within the horizon.

methodology.selection: Top 5%, 10%, and 20% of eligible symbols by technical rank in each fold.
methodology.metrics: Pooled precision, median fold precision, base rate, precision lift, recall and selected counts.
methodology.survivorship_bias: Material: the universe contains currently available symbols only; delisted/merged failures may be missing.
methodology.corporate_action_adjustment: Price-history adjustment status is not independently verified; split/bonus/dividend distortions may affect labels.
methodology.overlapping_horizons: Fold windows overlap and are not independent observations.
methodology.probability_calibration: No probability is displayed unless the predeclared precision gate passes; passing precision is still not a calibrated individual-stock probability.
